en.summary: This commit fixes a false L2 directory bypass hit: a same-set, same-tag write only counts as a hit if the write actually handshakes in that cycle.
why_it_counts: The patch changes active L2 directory hit logic in an instantiated DUT module.
It corrects functional read/write conflict handling rather than tests or tooling.
The fix is a one-term predicate repair and is easy to reverse precisely.
evidence: The diff changes `io.result.bits.hit` from `(hit || (setQuash && tagMatch))` to `(hit || (setQuash && tagMatch && io.write.fire))`.
Nearby code uses `Directory_test` as the live directory module instantiated by `Scheduler.scala`.
The commit subject explicitly names the `tagmatch setquash` bug.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache directory often bypasses a concurrent write into a same-cycle read result when the set and tag match. That bypass is only valid if the write is actually accepted in that cycle. If the logic treats a merely presented write as committed, the read path can report a false hit and skip the miss or replacement behavior that should have occurred.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The bug manifests when a directory read observes matching set/tag write metadata in the same cycle but the write is stalled and does not handshake.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop the write-handshake qualification from the bypass-hit predicate so an uncommitted write still forces a hit.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop handshake term from bypass predicate
portability_notes: Map this to any cache or directory block that supports read-after-write bypass or same-cycle forwarding.
The key requirement is a design that distinguishes write intent from write acceptance.
The injected fault should affect hit qualification only; do not change tag-compare logic itself.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the directory or tag-array logic that produces a hit result for a read while a same-cycle write is present.
Locate the predicate that combines set match and tag match for the bypass case.
Remove the ready/valid or fire-style condition that proves the write was actually accepted.
Keep all other hit and way-selection logic unchanged.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix requires `io.write.fire` in the `setQuash && tagMatch` bypass-hit path before `io.result.bits.hit` may report a hit.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: The changed line is the `io.result.bits.hit` assignment in `Directory_test.scala`, where same-cycle bypass hits are qualified.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The directory reports a hit for a read that should still miss, potentially suppressing allocation or replacement and corrupting later coherence or fill behavior.
evidence_for_injection: Only one boolean term changed, making the causal bug mechanism very clear.
The module is connected into the real L2 scheduler path, so the bug affects live directory behavior.
`setQuash` and `tagMatch` describe the bypass case; `io.write.fire` is the commit qualifier added by the fix.
notes: This is the cleanest same-cycle hazard bug in the four-commit `tagmatch setquash` series.
A targeted test should hold a matching write valid but not ready while a read probes the same set and tag.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了一个 L2 目录的伪旁路命中问题：只有当同周期、同 set、同 tag 的写请求真正握手成功时，才应该把它当成命中。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是已实例化 DUT 模块中的真实 L2 目录命中逻辑。
它修复的是读写冲突处理的功能行为，而不是测试或工具链。
该修复只是一个谓词项的修正，便于精确反向注入。
evidence: diff 把 `io.result.bits.hit` 从 `(hit || (setQuash && tagMatch))` 改成了 `(hit || (setQuash && tagMatch && io.write.fire))`。
附近代码显示 `Directory_test` 由 `Scheduler.scala` 作为真实目录模块实例化。
提交标题明确点名了 `tagmatch setquash` bug。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Cache 目录常常会把与当前读请求同周期发生的写入结果直接旁路给读结果，只要 set 和 tag 匹配即可。但这种旁路只有在写入真的被该周期接收时才成立。如果逻辑把“写请求已出现”误当成“写请求已提交”，读路径就会错误地报 hit，并跳过本应发生的 miss 或替换流程。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 目录旁路命中资格判定
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 当目录读在同一周期看到了 set/tag 匹配的写元数据，但该写请求其实因阻塞没有完成握手时，bug 会暴露。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 从旁路命中谓词中删除写握手成功条件，使未提交的写也能强行产生命中。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从旁路谓词中删除握手项
portability_notes: 可映射到任何支持读后写旁路或同周期转发的 cache 或目录模块。
关键前提是设计中能区分“写意图出现”和“写真正被接受”。
注入应只影响 hit 资格判定，不要改动 tag 比较逻辑本身。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到目录或 tag-array 中在同周期写存在时仍为读生成 hit 的逻辑。
定位那个把 set match 与 tag match 组合起来形成旁路命中的谓词。
删除 ready/valid 或 fire 之类用于证明写请求真正被接收的条件。
保持其他 hit 和 way 选择逻辑不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 目录旁路命中谓词
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复要求 `setQuash && tagMatch` 这条旁路命中路径必须满足 `io.write.fire`，`io.result.bits.hit` 才能报 hit。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 被修改的是 `Directory_test.scala` 中 `io.result.bits.hit` 的赋值语句，这里对同周期旁路命中进行了资格限定。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 目录会把本应 miss 的读错误地报告为 hit，从而抑制分配或替换，并进一步破坏后续一致性或填充行为。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁只改了一项布尔条件，因此 bug 机制非常清晰。
该模块连接在真实 L2 scheduler 路径上，所以故障会影响实际目录行为。
`setQuash` 与 `tagMatch` 描述的是旁路场景，而补丁新增的 `io.write.fire` 就是提交资格条件。
notes: 在四个 `tagmatch setquash` 系列提交中，这是最干净的同周期 hazard bug。
针对性测试可以让一个匹配写请求保持 valid 但不 ready，同时发起对相同 set 和 tag 的读。
